mapper.select: SELECT id, document_id, content, position, token_count, created_at FROM kb_chunk WHERE document_id = #{documentId} ORDER BY position ASC

SELECT id, document_id, content, position, token_count, created_at FROM kb_chunk WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) ORDER BY MATCH(content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, document_id, content, position, token_count, created_at FROM kb_chunk ORDER BY document_id, position ASC
